name: 芋香巨角蛛
evolution: 圆眼蜘蛛 → 尖角蜘蛛 Lv.24 → 芋香巨角蛛 Lv.40
description: 颜色鲜艳美丽，尾部丝囊中的液体有剧毒，织出的蜘蛛网散发异香。依靠体毒和利刺能轻易捕获猎物，从不群居，个体之间都保持一定距离，互不侵犯。
descriptionEn: Brightly and beautifully colored, the fluid in the silk glands at its tail is highly toxic, and the webs it spins give off a strange fragrance. Relying on its body venom and sharp spines it captures prey easily. It never lives in groups; individuals keep a certain distance from one another and do not encroach on each other.

skills.name: 蛰针
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 虫茧
skills.description: 自己回复20%生命，己方队伍获得1次奉献：获得10%吸血。
skills.descriptionEn: Self recovers 20% HP; your team gains 1 Dedication: gains 10% lifesteal.

skills.name: 虫网
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; self recovers 1 energy.

skills.name: 以毒攻毒
skills.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，自己获得魔攻+30%。
skills.descriptionEn: For each stack of Poison on the enemy, self gains Magic ATK +30%.

skills.name: 啃咬
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，本技能会受奉献影响，每被影响1次，能耗永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; 1 hit; this skill is affected by Dedication, and for each time it is affected, its energy cost permanently +1.

skills.name: 毒针
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains 1 stack of Poison.

skills.name: 贮藏
skills.description: 自己获得双攻+50%，每携带1个0能耗技能，额外+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains both ATK stats +50%; for each 0-energy-cost skill carried, an additional +50%.

skills.name: 毒泡泡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 落井下毒
skills.description: 使敌方精灵减益的层数翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Doubles the number of debuff stacks on the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 落星
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 腐蚀酸液
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得2层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; the enemy gains 2 stacks of Poison.

skills.name: 毒囊
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得2层中毒，应对状态：改为获得6层。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains 2 stacks of Poison; when countering a status skill: changed to 6 stacks.

skills.name: 毒液渗透
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层中毒效果，本技能能耗-1，敌方获得1层中毒。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each stack of Poison on the enemy, this skill's energy cost -1; the enemy gains 1 stack of Poison.

skills.name: 虫击
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为2倍，无视敌方系别抵抗。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when countering a status skill: this use's skill power becomes 2x and ignores the enemy's type resistance.
